theorems.name: Submission.dimred_tr_blowup_calculus
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (x : Euclid P) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam), (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), (blowUp T x lam hlam.ne').massOn W = ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ n) * T.massOn (dilation x lam ⁻¹' W)) ∧ (∀ ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n, currentEval (blowUp T x lam hlam.ne') ω = currentEval T (affinePullbackForm (dilationCLM P lam) (-(lam⁻¹ • x)) ω)) ∧ ∀ (y : Euclid P) (mu : ℝ) (hmu : 0 < mu) (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n), currentEval (blowUp (blowUp T x lam hlam.ne') y mu hmu.ne') ω = currentEval (blowUp T (x + lam • y) (lam * mu) (mul_pos hlam hmu).ne') ω
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
